protocol: VP-1.0 (Tier B: thresholds and key dates only)
note: Key dates = legislative steps stated in the text, entry into force, first-compliance / application dates, sunset or end of a regime. Purely procedural time limits (Board publication within 30 days, 60-day advance notice of changes) and the recurring semi-annual cycle are not listed as reference items, but annotated items covering them are judged on their merits.

items.quote:
